title: Aft Cargo and Tail Cone Wiring — Bulkhead Penetrations and Ground Points

ata.title: Aft Fuselage Wiring — Aft Cargo Wiring

abstract: Wiring diagram sheet for the aft cargo compartment and tail cone, showing every penetration of the rear pressure bulkhead, the ground point positions and the smoke detection sampling harness.

sections.purpose: This sheet shows the aft cargo compartment and tail cone wiring, with particular emphasis on the rear pressure bulkhead penetrations and the ground point positions behind the bulkhead.
sections.sheet_note: The sheet is drawn looking aft from the aft cargo compartment with the ceiling lining removed. Every penetration of the rear pressure bulkhead is numbered and each carries a pressure seal whose part number is on sheet 2; a penetration disturbed during structural work must have its seal renewed rather than reused. The smoke detection sampling harness is shown dashed because it is routed with the sampling tube and must keep its stated separation from the power runs.
sections.routing_note: The harness enters the aft cargo compartment at the forward bulkhead, runs aft along the ceiling in zones 143 and 146, and passes through the rear pressure bulkhead at penetrations 4, 7 and 11 into the tail cone in zone 193. Ground points are located on the bulkhead stiffeners immediately aft of the penetrations. Minimum separation between the smoke detection sampling harness and any power run is 60 millimetres. No harness may be attached to a radial segment of the bulkhead web itself. Bracket stations 4110W-B2, 4111W-B6 and 4118W-B3 carry the harness across the stabiliser attachment fitting area. A bracket station disturbed by structural work must be re-supported and not re-clipped to the nearest surviving station; no re-support scheme is published for any of the three.

ata.title: Aft Fuselage Wiring — Aft Cargo Wiring

abstract: Wiring diagram sheet for the aft cargo compartment and tail cone, showing the rear pressure bulkhead penetrations, the ground points, the smoke detection sampling harness and the re-support scheme for the three bracket stations in the attachment fitting area.

sections.purpose: This sheet shows the aft cargo compartment and tail cone wiring, with particular emphasis on the rear pressure bulkhead penetrations and the ground point positions behind the bulkhead.
sections.sheet_note: The sheet is drawn looking aft from the aft cargo compartment with the ceiling lining removed. Every penetration of the rear pressure bulkhead is numbered and each carries a pressure seal whose part number is on sheet 2; a penetration disturbed during structural work must have its seal renewed rather than reused. The smoke detection sampling harness is shown dashed because it is routed with the sampling tube and must keep its stated separation from the power runs. Sheet 3 carries the re-support scheme for the three bracket stations in the stabiliser attachment fitting area.
sections.routing_note: The harness enters the aft cargo compartment at the forward bulkhead, runs aft along the ceiling in zones 143 and 146, and passes through the rear pressure bulkhead at penetrations 4, 7 and 11 into the tail cone in zone 193. Ground points are located on the bulkhead stiffeners immediately aft of the penetrations. Minimum separation between the smoke detection sampling harness and any power run is 60 millimetres. No harness may be attached to a radial segment of the bulkhead web itself. Bracket stations 4110W-B2, 4111W-B6 and 4118W-B3 carry the harness across the stabiliser attachment fitting area and are all displaced by the forged fitting and its backing plate. Sheet 3 gives the re-support scheme for the three: the replacement feet, their positions on the section 19 frame rather than on the fitting itself, the revised harness lengths and the ground point relocation that goes with them. Re-clipping to a surviving station is not permitted, because it takes the smoke detection sampling harness inside its separation from the power run at penetration 7.
